source.build: scripts/huf-desktop/build.sh (renderer only: git archive HEAD -> npm ci --ignore-scripts -> vite build with scripts/huf-desktop/renderer.vite.config.mjs into .huf-cache/dist-desktop), then scripts/huf-desktop/tokens.mjs

captureMode.harness: scripts/huf-desktop/app.mjs (spec.harness = 'huf-desktop'; same openHuf/goHuf/liveCss API as scripts/huf/app.mjs)
captureMode.how: The real renderer served from the dist on http://desktop.mock; the Electron preload bridges (window.desktop, window.approvalPanel) are replaced before the bundle runs by scripts/huf-desktop/bridge.js; the Huf server (https://northwind.huf.example) is answered by scripts/huf-desktop/server.mjs; everything else is aborted. No Electron, no main process, no network.
captureMode.fixtures: data/huf/desktop.json (bridge: connection, workspaces, permission modes, executor, skills, MCP servers, policy; server: agents, conversations, messages; approval: panel states)
captureMode.routes: hash routes '#/chat/<conversation>', '#/settings/<category>'; the approval panel window is 'approval/index.html'

variableSystem.kind: css-custom-properties on :root (Tailwind v4 theme reads them)

themeAttribute.dark: class="dark" + data-theme="dark" on <html> (previews use data-theme="dark", which the CSS treats identically)

tokens.fonts: Inter and Geist Mono pinned (tokens/fonts, SIL OFL); fontsource and KaTeX files of the build in tokens/css/huf-desktop/fonts/
